name: mnaiwork-e2b-template
description: E2B template for MnaiWork generated React and ASP.NET Core projects

scripts.build: e2b template create mnaiwork-software-factory --path ../.. --dockerfile sandbox/e2bdocker/e2b.Dockerfile --cmd "dotnet /opt/mnaiwork-runner/MnaiWork.E2BRunner.dll --urls http://0.0.0.0:3000" --ready-cmd "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health" --cpu-count 2 --memory-mb 4096
scripts.local:verify: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2b.yml exec e2b-sandbox sh -lc "verify-toolchain && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health"
